conditions: Ordinary two-alternative or-pattern and a value for which both alternatives match.
limitations: This statement is about bindings selected by the or-pattern. A surrounding guard and the search of later case clauses use separate rules.

triggers: Publisher revision, byte drift, a source correction, contrary technical evidence, or a material scope correction.

statement: In the OCaml 5.3 reference, an or-pattern requires its alternatives to bind the same identifiers with the same types. If a value matches both alternatives, the match uses the bindings from the left alternative.
